text:
Ivy (Design): quick design scrub on the console form: when lots of fields error the whole page becomes unreadable. want low-noise patterns that still let users fix blockers fast.
Ben (Eng): agree. proposal: show a compact summary pill at top ("3 errors") + error chips inline for affected rows/fields. chips open a right-hand details panel. avoid full inline error dumps. :zap:
Ruth (PM): sounds good. for simple single-field mistakes show inline; for multi-field/bulk show pill + chips. can we keep the page height stable when errors appear?
Ivy (Design): yes 12 keep inline helper collapsed by default; expand helper on focus or when user opens details panel. also add a "Jump to first" control in the pill to focus the first blocking field.
Jia L: accessibility requirements: pill should use role="status" for non-blocking or role="alert" for submit-time blockers. make Jump-to-first keyboard operable and after focus set aria-describedby on the input so screen readers announce the error. use aria-invalid on bad inputs.
a11y-helper: checklist: "role=alert/status for summary", "aria-invalid on invalid fields", "aria-describedby linking to helper or error text", "chips have descriptive aria-labels (row N: missing required)", "details panel receives focus on open".
Ben (Eng): implementation note: chips -> panel reduces DOM churn. undo for destructive inline actions (remove mapping) should be modal + undo toast. typed-confirm reserved for high blast-radius deletes (tenants/models).
Ruth (PM): copy: modal primary should be explicit: "Remove mapping from pool" and toast: "Mapping removed  Undo" (8s). keep copy short; link to docs for edge cases.
Ivy (Design): required indicator decision: use a visible asterisk for forms but include hidden text for screen readers (programmatic aria-labels). for dense table/import UIs use header-level "*" with a tooltip "Required column" so cells aren't cluttered.
Jia L: prefer that. ensure header tooltip content is referenced via aria-describedby for each cell so SRs know a column is required. and don't rely on color alone for required or error states.
Ben (Eng): dev notes: preserve helper expansion state across validation cycles; undo should be client-first with server TTL to allow quick rehydrate if network hiccups happen.
Ivy (Design): action items: I'll make two small mocks (pill+chips+panel vs inline-with-collapsible-helpers), write the copy snippets for modal/toast, and add the a11y checklist. will post by tomorrow morning.
Ruth (PM): great, ping for dev review once mocks are up.
Ivy (Design): thanks all. :sparkles:
